title: Verve Therapeutics
summary: Cambridge, Massachusetts gene-editing company developing one-time treatments for cardiovascular disease.
bodyHtml:
Verve Therapeutics uses base editing to switch off genes that raise LDL cholesterol, aiming for a single treatment instead of lifelong medication.

Its lead programmes target PCSK9 and ANGPTL3, and the company is running early clinical studies.

Why it matters

  • Base editing
  • Cardiovascular gene therapy
  • One-time dosing

businessMeaning: Cardiovascular disease is the largest chronic market, and a one-time edit would be disruptive if durability and safety hold.
investmentLens: A listed clinical-stage company with binary trial risk and a long development runway.
